remaining_gaps: No atomic coordinates, CIF, unit-cell constants, occupancy refinement, interface lattice mapping or crystallographic atom model is supplied. SAED establishes author phase assignments only.

Instrument models, TEM voltage, XRF source/substrate/calibration, magnetic sample mass/state, full FC/ZFC protocol, SI-3 field, optical concentration and fluorescence correction details are absent.
